description: This source file defines a PHP class `AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI` which extends another class to implement an API endpoint for checking overlaps in punch-out records within an attendance module of an HRM system. It includes documentation, annotations for API specifications, and a method to process the request and return whether a punch-out overlaps with existing records.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API class providing an endpoint to check for punch-out record overlaps, extending the attendance punch-in record overlap API.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to determine if a punch-out overlaps with existing records, returning the result as a JSON object.
